findings.description: Direct inspection of all five V190 views and all six pose renders: the skirt still has severe irregular, triangular faceting across the front and three-quarter views, with a smooth back panel inconsistent with the intended pleated surface. In crouch, lap coverage remains partial around the raised thighs and the hem breaks into sharp panels. In sit, the apron hangs behind/between the legs while broad anterior thighs remain exposed.

The V190 front, side, three-quarter, and prone views still show angular planar folds across the bodice, a gray waist patch with unverified garment-surface ownership, and a stiff, irregular waist/back transition. Bodice appearance remains unacceptable.

V190 source-bound geometric evidence: pose-space same-side thigh targets (crouch and sit) mapped back through barycentric avatar skin transforms; 108 exact authored front-lap hem vertices and 53/54 open hem edges preserved. Requested maximum blend was 0.90, but orientation backtracking reduced mean applied blend to 0.2337 and backtracked 2,446 vertices. Unique anterior-thigh ray hits were 50/532 crouch and 21/532 sit, only +2 and +1 from V189 48/532 and 20/532. Current direct renders still show large uncovered thigh regions. These diagnostics are not fit evidence.
